categories.main_business_segments: Kunshan Guoli Electronic Technology Co., Ltd. specializes in the research, development, production, and sales of electronic vacuum devices. Its product portfolio includes vacuum relays, vacuum capacitors, vacuum interrupters, thyratrons, magnetrons, traveling wave tubes, vacuum contactors, and circuit breakers. The company serves multiple sectors including new energy vehicles and charging facilities, aerospace and military, semiconductor equipment manufacturing, photovoltaic wind energy and energy storage, traditional energy, security inspection, and irradiation.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has developed proprietary core technologies covering all key processes of electronic vacuum device manufacturing, including advanced ceramic-metal bonding, vacuum sealing welding, and specialized design and manufacturing techniques for vacuum interrupters, vacuum relays, high-power thyratrons, magnetrons, vacuum capacitors, DC contactors, and AC contactors. It employs automated production lines and digital management systems such as PLM and ERP to enhance production efficiency and quality control. The company also focuses on miniaturization, high reliability, and long service life of its products.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are manufacturers and integrators in the new energy vehicle sector, aerospace and military industries, semiconductor equipment manufacturers, photovoltaic and wind energy companies, traditional energy sectors like coal mining and power distribution, security inspection, and large scientific engineering projects. The company has established strategic partnerships with leading domestic and international clients in these fields, including battery and vehicle manufacturers in the new energy sector.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company primarily operates in China with its headquarters and production facilities in Kunshan, Jiangsu Province. It also exports products to multiple countries including the United States. Domestic sales dominate, accounting for approximately 78% of revenue, while overseas markets contribute around 22%.
categories.supply_chain_position: Guoli operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on the design, manufacturing, and assembly of electronic vacuum components that are critical parts for downstream equipment manufacturers in various high-tech industries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in high-voltage, high-frequency, and high-reliability vacuum devices, targeting product miniaturization, weight reduction, and performance enhancement. R&D efforts focus on new product development such as high-performance vacuum capacitors, advanced DC and AC contactors for energy storage and new energy vehicles, and high-power active vacuum devices for scientific and industrial applications. It invests heavily in digital transformation and automation to improve manufacturing capabilities and quality management.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of electronic vacuum devices to equipment manufacturers and system integrators. The company also engages in customized product development and provides technical services and consulting. Sales are conducted mainly through direct sales channels, with some business through trading partners.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Guoli is a leading domestic player in the electronic vacuum device industry, competing with companies like Hongfa Technology in the new energy vehicle contactor market and international brands in semiconductor vacuum capacitors. While it has achieved significant market recognition and technological parity in several product lines, it faces competition from established multinational corporations such as TE Connectivity, Panasonic, and Siemens, especially in high-end semiconductor and aerospace applications.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 692 million, a slight decrease of 1.12% year-over-year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 64.2 million, down 24.85%. Total assets grew by 38.19% to RMB 2.06 billion, mainly due to convertible bond issuance. The company maintains a stable growth trajectory with ongoing investments in R&D and production capacity expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Guoli emphasizes its comprehensive in-house core technology platform enabling full control over the design and manufacturing process, ensuring high reliability, long service life, and customization capabilities. Its products are tailored for demanding applications in new energy vehicles, aerospace, military, and semiconductor industries, offering superior performance such as high voltage endurance, rapid arc extinguishing, and compact design. The company also highlights its strong customer service, strategic partnerships, and continuous innovation as key differentiators.
